calibration.choice: highest factor passing all five outer folds
calibration.inner: for each outer held-out title H, each of the 4 training titles is scored by a model trained on the other 3 training titles; m_H = minimum positive-cell score over those inner held-out predictions; H contributes nothing
calibration.r_definition: R = ML-selected cells UNION certain-code seed cells (cells holding a precise direct-control-discovery identity)
calibration.r_gate: C outside R = 0 and R/ROM <= 0.6 (preferred 0.5) on every outer title

environment.deterministic: torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True), fixed seed and fixed thread count

metrics.frf: smallest fraction of cells, taken in descending model score, containing every positive cell; ties with the lowest positive are all counted

M0.what: frozen production SEG-047 v1 (512-B windows, 141 features, Sonic-1-trained logistic, threshold 0.00835406801187952), no retraining; each 128-B cell inherits its window probability

features.per_scale: 6 byte statistics + 8 byte-bucket fractions + 57 token-class fractions (from the same 128-B cell / 1024-B context representation)

architecture.equivalence: a valid-convolution trunk makes every cell's logit a function of exactly its 512-word context; whole-ROM/segment evaluation is therefore identical to per-cell evaluation (checked by test)
architecture.head: concat(mean over cell positions, max over cell positions, mean over all 226 context positions, max over all 226) = 256 -> Linear(256,64) -> ReLU -> Linear(64,1) -> logit; probability = sigmoid(logit)
architecture.input: word-resolution sequence of 512 positions (1024-byte context); per position concat(embed(hi byte), embed(lo byte)[, token embeddings])
architecture.valid_geometry: context 512 words -> stem 508 -> b2 500 -> pool 250 -> b3 242 -> b4 226 final positions; the cell occupies final positions [97, 129) (32 positions = 64 words)

hard_positive.rule: at the end of epochs 10 and 20, score the TRAINING titles only (eval mode); training positive cells whose score is below the 10th percentile of the pooled training-positive scores get loss multiplier 4.0 (weights are reset to 1 and re-mined at each mining epoch); cell identities are runtime-only

recipe.epoch_definition: per training title a random cell offset in [0, 32) (seeded) partitions the title into 32-cell segments; the segment list of all training titles is shuffled and consumed in batches of 8

hard_positive.rule: at the end of epochs 10 and 20, score the TRAINING titles only (eval mode); training positive cells whose score is below the 10th percentile of the pooled training-positive scores get loss multiplier 4.0 (weights are reset to 1 and re-mined at each mining epoch); cell identities are runtime-only

recipe.loss: BCEWithLogits, pos_weight = (#negative cells)/(#positive cells) over the TRAINING titles, per-cell weight
recipe.lr_schedule: cosine annealing to 0 over all steps (per-step)

representation.edge: word-block symmetric reflection; no positional input
representation.label: cell positive iff it contains >= 1 source-backed MC68000 instruction start

token_definition.control: 0 none, 1 conditional (Bcc/DBcc), 2 direct jump, 3 direct call, 4 dynamic jump, 5 dynamic call, 6 return, 7 always-exception or trap
token_definition.ea_dst: M68kEaMode ordinal of the destination operand (0 unused .. 12 pc_index8)
token_definition.ea_src: M68kEaMode ordinal of the source operand (0 unused .. 12 pc_index8)
token_definition.family: 1 move, 2 arithmetic/compare, 3 logic/bit, 4 shift/rotate, 5 control-flow, 6 exception-raising, 7 other; 0 when status = 0
token_definition.flags: bit0 privileged instruction, bit1 PC-relative displacement control form
token_definition.length: instruction length in words 1..4, 5 = five or more; 0 when status = 0
token_definition.never_emitted: decoded target address, ROM position, ordinal, title, symbol, source label, runtime frequency
token_definition.status: 0 rejected by the decoder, 1 architectural exception form (illegal / line A / line F), 2 ordinary instruction
token_definition.width: operand width when an operand EA exists: 1 byte, 2 word, 3 long; 0 otherwise

scope: OFFLINE research; production Optimized AOT and SEG-047 v1 artifacts are unchanged

selection.materiality: candidates whose worst-title FRF is within 0.02 of the best form the tie set; a more complex candidate replaces a simpler one only if its mean (or worst) FRF is lower by >= 0.02; otherwise the simpler model wins
selection.order: viable -> lowest worst-title FRF -> lowest mean FRF -> smaller/simpler model
selection.viable: FRF <= 0.6 on every one of the five held-out titles

stage_separation: C outside R is computed from the ML proposal first; K comes from the unchanged structural prune; C in R but outside K is POST_ML_PRUNING_BLOCKER and never an ML false negative
status: FROZEN BEFORE ANY M1-M4 TITLE-HELD-OUT RESULT
